name: Integrated Horticulture Development Program for Tribal Area Farmers (TASP) HRT-3
benefit:
> **Capacity Building & Promotion:**

- Assistance for publication and promotional materials related to horticultural crops.
- Financial support for organizing and participating in exhibitions, competitions, and seminars.
- Subsidy for organizing or participating in Krishi Melas and payment for stall rentals.

> **Farm Mechanization Support:**

- Subsidy for purchase of power tillers and mini
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. - The applicant should be practicing horticulture in tribal areas.
